published.system: Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM)

statement: On the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split the grid program search solved 71 of 400 tasks (17.75 percent) with one attempt per task, no model and a 3000 ms wall clock budget per task, mean 2463.52 ms per task. 1 exhausted the vocabulary, 321 ran out of clock, 7 found a program that fit every train pair and missed a test output. Every solved answer is what a chain of grid.dsl cells emitted after grid.dsl.match cells confirmed every train pair. This is the held out EVALUATION split; the published no-model row is Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM) at 17 percent on the evaluation split.
